title: Cows Grazing in Rural Pasture Field, 1965 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot photo stamped 'SEP 65' along the bottom scalloped margin, depicting a small herd of cows grazing in an overgrown grassy pasture near a dense treeline. To the far right, a small distant figure dressed in white stands near the edge of the woods. The scene evokes peaceful, mid-20th-century rural agricultural life.
